threat_event: Unauthorized person uses Integrator B's always-on remote desktop agent on the Ridge engineering workstation to operate the HMI and change the sodium hypochlorite feed at WTP-G1 or WTP-G2
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist targeting internet-reachable water systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on agent with a password only, no session approval, and no company logging; flat Ridge control network; shared operator logins; WTP-G2 unstaffed at night
existing_controls: Hardwired stroke limits and analyzer alarms at both Ridge plants; manual (local) control available; Ridge operators on site 16 hours a day
treatment_plan: Remove the agent; move Integrator B to the OT remote access gateway with MFA, ROC approval, and recording; Integrator B contract amendment; OT runbook and tabletop (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$2.5M (Tier 1 notice and boil water response for up to 27,400 people; enforcement; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Attacker uses stolen or guessed credentials on the password-only Lakes on-call VPN to reach the flat Lakes control network and operate WTP-L1 HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: On-call VPN with password only (no MFA); flat control network at WTP-L1; shared HMI logins; no OT monitoring at Lakes
existing_controls: VPN lockout after 10 failed attempts; hardwired limits and alarms; WTP-L1 staffed 24x7
treatment_plan: Retire the on-call VPN; on-call operators use the gateway with MFA; phishing-resistant MFA for engineers by 2027-03-31
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$4M (Tier 1 notice and boil water response for 63,500 people)

threat_event: An attacker who compromises an acquired plant moves through the any-to-any site-to-site VPNs into the Regional control network and the ROC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Site-to-site VPNs from Lakes and Ridge (March 2026) allow any-to-any traffic; deny-by-default not applied to the tunnels
existing_controls: Regional OT DMZ and IT/OT firewall; passive OT monitoring at WTP-R1 and WTP-R2 alerting the MSSP
treatment_plan: Restrict tunnels to named flows (SCADA client views and alarms only); isolate Ridge SCADA behind a dedicated firewall; monitor tunnel traffic
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$6M (loss of central supervision for 11 systems; manual operation; possible Regional Tier 1 notice)

threat_event: Attacker reaches the web administration page of an internet-exposed small-system cellular modem and changes the well controller settings or disables chlorination
threat_source: Opportunistic attacker scanning for exposed devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 small-system modems with web administration reachable from the internet; default credentials found in P07 (changed 2026-08-13 as an interim step); controller logic not backed up
existing_controls: Daily roving operator visits; daily residual checks; carrier private network for the other 22 modems
treatment_plan: Move the 3 modems to the private carrier network and disable web administration; quarterly external exposure scans; modem hardening baseline in STD-01
exposure_estimate_usd: $75K-$400K per affected small system (notice, flushing, sampling, response for up to 2,900 people)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts business endpoints, servers, and cloud file services and halts customer service, billing, field dispatch, and Utility Services billing (double extortion with customer data theft)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing directory and SaaS administrator rights; 23 non-expiring service account passwords; CIS restore of company data untested; field staff without email receive awareness only at hire
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-15; SYS-07; SYS-09; SYS-10; BP-10 to BP-14; BP-16
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171; Contract (Utility Services agreements); C-WATER-R01 (300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii))
existing_controls: MFA for all users; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; immutable cloud backups in a separate account; OT segmented from IT at Regional
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for directory and SaaS administrators; vault and rotate service accounts; CIS data restore test; ransomware tabletop with counsel (P08 runbook 2)
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (response, notification to up to 123,400 accounts, delayed cash, client credits; insurance limit $15M, retention $500K)

threat_event: Customer personal information in the CIS (online account credentials and bank account details for automatic payments) is stolen through a compromised administrator account or a CIS vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monthly CIS export review started only 2026-08; client billing roles broad until 2026-07; breach decision log not yet in use
existing_controls: SSO and MFA for staff; vendor SOC 2 Type 2; role per client
treatment_plan: Monthly export review; data loss alerting on bulk exports; breach decision log and notice templates (P08); vendor notice term of 72 hours at renewal
exposure_estimate_usd: $600K-$2.5M (notice to up to 123,400 accounts, call center, credit monitoring, client contract claims)

threat_event: Malware in business IT reaches the Lakes control network through the dual-homed Lakes historian
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lakes historian has one interface on the business LAN and one on the flat control network
existing_controls: EDR on the historian (business side); WTP-L1 staffed 24x7 with manual operation drilled yearly
treatment_plan: Remove the business interface; replicate through a Lakes OT DMZ; interim firewall rule on the business side

threat_event: Lakes or Ridge SCADA is lost (failure, ransomware, or a bad change) and cannot be rebuilt within the 24-hour RTO
threat_source: Equipment failure, cyber incident, or vendor dependence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tested rebuild procedure; no in-house known-good copies of logic, projects, or images; Integrator B has no response-time commitment; Ridge server on an unsupported operating system
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; SYS-02 (Lakes and Ridge); BP-02; BP-03; BP-06
existing_controls: Manual operation; Integrator B holds copies (unverified); standby generators
treatment_plan: Offline backups of logic, projects, and images at Lakes, Ridge, and small systems; documented rebuild procedure; rebuild test at Lakes 2027-01 and Ridge 2027-03; Integrator B response terms
exposure_estimate_usd: $400K-$1.2M (extended manual operation, integrator emergency rates, overtime)

threat_event: PLC logic at Lakes, Ridge, or a small system is altered (by an attacker or a faulty integrator change) and the change goes unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No company baseline or integrity check at Lakes, Ridge, or small systems; Integrator B writes and loads logic with no company approval
existing_controls: Hardwired limits and alarms; operator rounds
treatment_plan: Capture known-good logic; quarterly comparison and after every change; company approval for Integrator B changes

threat_event: A former employee or contractor uses a shared HMI or engineering login at Lakes, Ridge, or a small system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared logins; OT local accounts not on the termination checklist; P07 found 4 of 25 sampled leavers with active OT local accounts
existing_controls: Badge-controlled control rooms; Regional named accounts
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts at Lakes and Ridge by 2026-12-31 and small systems by 2027-03-31; OT accounts on the termination checklist; quarterly access reviews

threat_event: An attacker logs in to a small-system controller, modem, or a Lakes or Ridge PLC using a default or unchanged commissioning password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default credentials on small-system controllers and modems; Lakes and Ridge PLC passwords unchanged since commissioning and kept in an integrator spreadsheet
existing_controls: Regional device credentials vaulted and changed in 2025
treatment_plan: Change and vault every device credential; remove the integrator spreadsheet; STD-04 rotation rules for OT devices

threat_event: An OT intrusion at Lakes, Ridge, or a small system goes undetected, or a Regional OT alert reaches the ROC too late to act
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT monitoring only at WTP-R1 and WTP-R2; no logs from Lakes, Ridge, or small systems; MSSP has no OT playbooks or ROC escalation path (P07: one alert took 9 hours to reach the ROC)
existing_controls: Passive OT sensors at the Regional plants; MSSP 24x7 for IT; hardwired alarms
treatment_plan: OT playbooks and ROC escalation within 15 minutes (2026-11-30); passive sensors at WTP-L1 and WTP-G1 (2027-06-30); log collection from Lakes and Ridge SCADA and VPNs

threat_event: Integrator B is compromised and its tools, accounts, or project files are used to attack Lakes and Ridge
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inherited contracts with no security terms; never assessed; standing administrator access at Ridge; holds the only copies of project files
existing_controls: None specific beyond the hardwired safeguards
treatment_plan: Security amendment (MFA, gateway-only access, 24-hour incident notice, background checks, return of project files); first assessment by 2026-12-31; re-bid support at 2027 renewal

threat_event: One of the 14 OT vendors with remote access (instrument, pump, membrane, AMI field service, carrier, radio, generator) has its account misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor reviews only at onboarding; 1 of 13 gateway vendors without a signed access agreement
existing_controls: Regional vendor access through the gateway with approval and recording
treatment_plan: Tiered annual vendor reviews (STD-08); signed access agreement before any session

threat_event: An attacker on the Lakes network downloads new logic to a PLC left in remote-program mode
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found 2 of 4 Lakes PLCs in remote-program mode; key switch positions not checked on rounds
existing_controls: Regional key switches kept in RUN except during approved changes
treatment_plan: Key switches to RUN at all plants; key switch position on daily rounds; change procedure

threat_event: Malware exploits the unsupported operating system on the Ridge SCADA server or engineering workstation and disables Ridge supervision
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past end of support with no compensating controls beyond the VPN; no endpoint protection; not patched since acquisition
existing_controls: Manual operation; 16-hour staffing at WTP-G1
treatment_plan: Interim isolation behind a dedicated firewall and allowlisting (2026-12-31); replace the Ridge platform on a supported system (2027 capital plan)

threat_event: Known vulnerabilities in the Lakes platform (not patched since the 2023 acquisition) are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability identification or patching at Lakes and Ridge; no vendor qualification process for these platforms
existing_controls: Weekly advisory review by the OT security analyst (Regional platforms)
treatment_plan: Passive vulnerability identification at Lakes and Ridge; quarterly vendor-qualified patching through a Lakes OT DMZ patch server

threat_event: Unknown devices at Lakes, Ridge, or the small systems (11 found at Lakes; modems not inventoried) are exploited or fail without anyone knowing they exist
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT inventory complete only at Regional; acquired systems rely on integrator drawings
existing_controls: Regional inventory from passive discovery
treatment_plan: Site surveys and passive discovery at Lakes and Ridge; modem inventory with the carrier; reconcile quarterly

threat_event: During a SCADA outage, manual operation at a plant fails or starts late because manual-mode procedures are not written for every chemical feed and Ridge has not drilled since acquisition
threat_source: Loss of SCADA from any cause
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Written procedures only at Regional; Lakes drilled once a year; Ridge no drill and WTP-G2 unstaffed (on-call drive about 35 minutes)
affected_asset_or_process: BP-01 to BP-05; WTP-G1; WTP-G2; WTP-L1
existing_controls: Licensed operators; hardwired limits and alarms; Regional drills twice a year
treatment_plan: Write manual-mode procedures for each chemical feed at every plant; drill Ridge before 2026-12-04 and twice a year at all covered plants; on-call staffing plan for WTP-G2
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$2.5M (boil water notice if off-spec water reaches customers)

threat_event: A hurricane causes extended loss of utility power, telemetry, and road access across several systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 of 41 wells without standby generators; small systems and Lakes and Ridge telemetry on one cellular carrier
affected_asset_or_process: All plants and wells; SYS-03; BP-01 to BP-05
existing_controls: Generators at all plants and 30 of 41 wells; fuel contract; WARN mutual aid; hurricane annex exercised annually
treatment_plan: Portable generators and quick-connects for the remaining 11 wells (capital plan); second carrier or satellite backup for critical modems

threat_event: The ROC is lost (fire, flood, hurricane, or a cyber incident) and 11 systems and 3 clients lose central supervision
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single control room; no alternate position; client monitoring has no fallback beyond the clients' own dialers
existing_controls: Plants run locally; standby SCADA server at WTP-R2
treatment_plan: Equip and test an alternate ROC position at WTP-R2 with client monitoring views

threat_event: A cellular carrier outage cuts telemetry from 25 sites at Lakes, Ridge, and the small systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier, no alternate path
existing_controls: Roving operators; local controls keep running
treatment_plan: Alternate path for the 10 most critical sites

threat_event: An authorized Regional operator or engineer makes an unsafe setpoint change by mistake or on purpose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Change approval and named accounts in place; error remains possible
existing_controls: Named accounts; approval for logic changes; hardwired limits and alarms; HMI event history
treatment_plan: Setpoint change alarms reviewed by the shift supervisor; annual review of HMI limit settings

threat_event: The revised Ridge ERP is not completed with cyber procedures and certified by 2026-12-24, or the Lakes ERP keeps a cyber annex that does not fit its platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ridge ERP has no cyber procedures; Lakes annex copied from Regional; one Emergency Management and Resilience Manager for 3 systems
existing_controls: RRA certified 2026-06-24; ERP draft in progress; internal target 2026-12-04
treatment_plan: Weekly ERP status to the COO; cyber annex built from P08 and P05; Lakes annex replaced at the next revision

threat_event: RRA cyber elements do not reflect current risk: the Regional 2025 RRA predates the March 2026 interconnection, and the Lakes cyber element was copied from Regional
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interconnection after the RRA; no RRA update trigger in the program
existing_controls: This register serves as the cyber addendum to all 3 RRAs
treatment_plan: Adopt this register as a dated addendum to each RRA; trigger an RRA update after any acquisition or interconnection

threat_event: During a real OT cyber incident, responders lose time because no ERP has been exercised with an OT cyber scenario
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT cyber exercise at any system; first tabletop 2026-11-17
existing_controls: IT incident exercises; hurricane exercises
treatment_plan: OT tabletop 2026-11-17; functional exercise with Ridge and Integrator B in 2027 Q2; annual thereafter

threat_event: A Tier 1 public notice is late or does not reach everyone because the CIS or email is down, offline contact exports exist only for Regional, and Spanish-language templates are missing
threat_source: Any incident that disables business IT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offline exports for Regional only; no Spanish templates; cyber trigger not in the public notice SOP
existing_controls: Tier 1 templates and boil water procedures per system; broadcast media contacts
treatment_plan: Monthly offline exports for all 11 systems and the wholesale city; Spanish templates; cyber trigger in the SOP

threat_event: Continuous residual monitoring is lost during a SCADA outage and the required 4-hour grab sampling or the next-business-day report is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Grab sampling procedure exists but is not tied to cyber incident triggers at Lakes and Ridge
existing_controls: Laboratory staff and portable kits; Regional procedure
treatment_plan: Add the grab sampling and reporting steps to both P08 runbooks and the ERPs

threat_event: RRA and ERP contents, SCADA drawings, or critical asset maps leak through over-shared files, the generative AI assistant, an acquisition data room, or a vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 ERP folders were open to all staff (fixed 2026-08-28); data lake and file audit logs not in the SIEM; AI-006 inherits file permissions
existing_controls: Restricted classification (POL-04); group-based libraries
treatment_plan: Quarterly permission review of Restricted libraries; file audit logs to the SIEM; AI-006 sensitivity labels

threat_event: A business email compromise redirects a payment to a chemical supplier or capital contractor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank change requests verified by email only for capital contractors
existing_controls: MFA; EDR; email filtering; call-back for chemical suppliers
treatment_plan: Call-back to a known number for all bank changes; finance phishing training

threat_event: An attacker takes over a directory or SaaS administrator account with standing rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged access management covers only cloud administrators and the OT gateway
existing_controls: MFA for all administrators; EDR
treatment_plan: Extend privileged access management to directory and SaaS administrators; phishing-resistant MFA for all administrators

threat_event: A service account with a non-expiring password is used for lateral movement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 service accounts with non-expiring passwords, some with broad rights
existing_controls: EDR; MSSP monitoring
treatment_plan: Vault and rotate; convert to managed service identities where supported

threat_event: Access is not removed or adjusted promptly at termination or transfer (96 terminations and 51 transfers in 12 months)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual access reviews (last February 2026); transfers keep prior roles in some SaaS systems
existing_controls: Automated disable from the HR feed for identity provider accounts
treatment_plan: Quarterly access reviews; transfer workflow removes prior roles

threat_event: Field and plant staff without company email fall for SMS or voice phishing that targets their tablet credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 110 field and plant staff get awareness training only at hire
existing_controls: MFA on tablets; mobile device management
treatment_plan: Annual awareness for all staff through the learning system on tablets; quarterly SMS phishing simulation

threat_event: A ransomware attack at the CIS vendor stops billing and customer service for own and client accounts beyond the MTD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One CIS vendor; company restore of its own data untested; client billing SLA 2 business days
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 with annual DR test; estimated billing procedure
treatment_plan: Weekly company-held export of billing data; vendor outage procedure in P08 runbook 2; recovery terms at renewal

threat_event: The ROC misses the 15-minute alarm acknowledgment for a municipal client during an incident or alarm flood
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client alarms share the ROC alarm list; no alarm priority separation
existing_controls: 24x7 ROC staffing; client on-call call-out list
treatment_plan: Separate client alarm queue; alarm flood procedure; quarterly SLA report to clients

threat_event: A municipal client does not renew Utility Services because no SOC 2 Type 2 report is available by its 2027 renewal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Type 2 observation period starts 2027-04-01; readiness gaps (P09)
existing_controls: Clients informed of the readiness plan; quarterly status
treatment_plan: Execute the P09 roadmap; offer a Type 1 report for 2027-03-31
exposure_estimate_usd: Up to $3M a year of revenue per client

threat_event: The ROC's read-only connection to a municipal client is used to attack the client, or a client compromise reaches the ROC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Read-only views through dedicated firewalls; interconnection terms signed
existing_controls: Read-only views; dedicated firewall per client; written interconnection terms
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO within appetite; reviewed yearly with each client

threat_event: AMI interval data for identifiable customers is exposed or misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interval extracts copied to the data lake for leak analytics
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2; named analyst access
treatment_plan: Pseudonymize extracts in the data lake; quarterly access review

threat_event: Laboratory results in the LIMS are altered or lost, leading to wrong compliance reports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edits require a reason code; weekly audit review
existing_controls: State-certified lab procedures; second-person review of state reports
treatment_plan: Monthly export of state reports to file services; annual vendor review

threat_event: A misconfiguration in the cloud landing zone exposes process data or opens an inbound path toward the OT DMZ
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails and one-way design in place; drift possible
existing_controls: Guardrails; posture management; deny-by-default firewall; inbound blocked at the IT/OT firewall
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of routes and guardrails; alert on any route change toward the OT DMZ tunnel

threat_event: An attacker with cloud administrator rights deletes or encrypts cloud backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups isolated, write-once, separate credentials; historian replica rebuild untested
existing_controls: Separate backup account and region; 35-day write-once lock; non-federated administrators
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: isolation and write-once retention make loss unlikely; first replica rebuild test 2026-11-10

threat_event: AI-001 anomaly detection misses a real water quality event or floods operators with false alerts, and operators come to over-trust or ignore it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Not validated before use; vendor updates without notice; covers Regional only
existing_controls: SCADA alarms and grab sampling remain the controls of record; advisory labels
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: validation thresholds, pinned versions, change notice, operator briefing

threat_event: An operator applies an unsafe chemical dose recommended by the AI-002 pilot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without review; recommendations look authoritative on the HMI side screen
existing_controls: Hardwired stroke limits; operator approval for every setpoint; no write path to SCADA
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: limit to WTP-R2 pilot with Chief Operator sign-off for each change; no write path ever without COO approval

threat_event: The contact center virtual agent (AI-004) gives a caller another customer's account details or wrong shutoff or notice information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Caller verification relies on account number and address; call summaries stored without review
existing_controls: Vendor controls; agent cannot change payment details
treatment_plan: Stronger caller verification; restrict the agent to scripted answers during notices; monthly transcript sampling

threat_event: Staff paste Restricted RRA, ERP, or SCADA content or customer data into a generative AI tool, or the enterprise assistant (AI-006) surfaces over-shared files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enterprise assistant enabled 2026-05 without a review; public chatbots not blocked on all devices
existing_controls: POL-05 approved-tools rule; enterprise terms with no training on company data
treatment_plan: Sensitivity labels on Restricted libraries; block public chatbots on managed devices; AI-006 conditions (P10)

threat_event: The main-break likelihood model (AI-005) steers replacement spending away from some neighborhoods because of data gaps in acquired systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Acquired systems have sparse break history; model not reviewed for fairness across systems
existing_controls: Engineers review the capital plan; model is one input
treatment_plan: Fairness check by system and service area before the 2027 capital plan

threat_event: AMI leak analytics (AI-003) send false leak alerts or miss leaks, leading to billing disputes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer-facing alert wording implies detection
existing_controls: Informational alerts only; manual review of adjustments
treatment_plan: Revise customer wording; quarterly accuracy sample

threat_event: An attacker intercepts or injects traffic on the unencrypted licensed radio telemetry at the Regional System
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Licensed radio protocol has no encryption; compensated by protocol filtering at the master radio
existing_controls: Protocol filtering at the master radio; RTU intrusion alarms; tank level cross-checks
treatment_plan: Accepted by the SCADA and Controls Engineering Manager (Low); revisit when radios are replaced

threat_event: A future acquisition is connected to the ROC before its OT risks are known, repeating the Lakes and Ridge pattern
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No acquisition integration standard; the 2026 VPNs were built before any security review
existing_controls: Due diligence covers finances and water quality, not OT security
treatment_plan: STD-07 acquisition integration standard: OT assessment before close, isolation until baseline controls are met, RRA update trigger

threat_event: Someone enters an unstaffed small-system site and tampers with the chlorinator or well controller
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locks and fences only; P07 found one control panel unlocked; keys not inventoried
existing_controls: Daily roving visits; daily residual checks
treatment_plan: Lock and key control; door switches on panels reported through the modem; key inventory

threat_event: Sodium hypochlorite or another treatment chemical cannot be delivered for several days (supplier shortage or supplier cyber incident)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two hypochlorite suppliers; on-site storage 10 to 14 days at major plants, 5 to 7 at small systems
existing_controls: Two suppliers; inventory tracking; WARN mutual aid
treatment_plan: Minimum inventory alarms; supplier continuity questions in annual review

threat_event: A state-sponsored actor that has quietly gained access to business IT pivots to the OT DMZ and pre-positions for a disruptive attack on the Regional System
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Living-off-the-land techniques are hard to detect; directory administrators hold standing rights; OT DMZ servers trust some business accounts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-15; SYS-06 (OT DMZ); SYS-01; BP-01; BP-06
existing_controls: IT/OT firewall deny-by-default; OT DMZ; passive OT monitoring; MSSP 24x7; water-sector ISAC alerts
treatment_plan: Separate OT DMZ identities from the business directory; threat hunt for living-off-the-land activity twice a year; CISA advisories mapped to detections
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$10M (loss of central control and possible Regional Tier 1 notice)
